Major AI Developments.title: Jharkhand Boosts Technical Education with AI & Emerging Tech Centres of Excellence
Major AI Developments.summary: Jharkhand's higher and technical education department is setting up Centres of Excellence at BIT Sindri and GEC Palamu to enhance technical education. The centres will focus on AI and emerging technologies, providing students with industry-aligned learning opportunities and hands-on experience. This initiative aims to improve employability and placement outcomes for students.
